title: CPSC, Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Doll Feeding Sets
summary: The doll bib in the set has snaps that detach, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 700,000.

title: CPSC, Appliance Co. of America Announce Recall of Toaster Ovens
summary: The ovens' heating elements can break, causing the glass door to shatter. The toasters could short circuit, causing electrical shocks and fires. Units: About 7,000.

title: CPSC, The First Years Inc. Announce Recall to Replace "Elmo Nitelights"
summary: The faceplate on these nightlights can be broken off, exposing wiring and posing shock and electrocution hazards. Units: About 123,000.

title: CPSC, Burley Design Cooperative Announce Recall to Repair Burely-Bravo™ Bicycle Trailers
summary: The wheel can separate from these trailers during use, and result in crashes and injuries to children riding inside. Loss of control to the bicycle pulling these trailers also can cause the riders to crash and suffer injuries. Units: About 2,200.

title: CPSC, Cycle Express Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
summary: These helmets fail impact testing and labeling required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not adequately protected from falls, and could suffer severe head injuries or death. Units: About 9,000.

title: CPSC, Rand International Announce Recall of Bicycle Helmets
summary: These bicycle helmets fail impact testing and labeling required under CPSC's Safety Standard for Bicycle Helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Riders wearing these helmets are not properly protected from falls, and could suffer severe head injuries. Units: About 70,000.

title: CPSC, AmeriGas Propane L.P. Announce Recall of Propane Cylinders
summary: Of these cylinders, about 10 could be overfilled, which can cause them to release flammable propane gas unexpectedly, posing a risk of fires and explosions. Units: About 100.

title: CPSC, Hufco-Delaware Co. Announce Recall to Repair Gerry® TrailTech™ Backpack Baby Carriers
summary: Small infants can shift to one side, slip through the leg openings of these carriers and fall. Units: about 111,000.

title: CPSC, Gymboree Announce Recall of Plush Shape Sorters and Stacking Toys
summary: The stuffing of the toys can contain sewing needles and sharp metal pieces. Young children could ingest or be cut by these sharp metal pieces. Units: about 19,000 Plush Shape Sorter toys and about 12,000 Plush Stacking toys.

title: CPSC, Master Lock Co. Announce Recall to Replace Gun Locks
summary: Due to a manufacturing discrepancy, the two halves of some gun locks can be manually separated without a key, giving children and others unauthorized access to a firearm. Units: About 752,000.

title: CPSC, Child GuidanceTM Announce Recall to Replace Caterpillar Toys
summary: Young children can choke on the small balls attached to these toys. Units: Almost 1 million.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Baby Jumper Seats and Construction Toys
summary: The spring that suspends the jumper seat from the doorway can break. Babies can fall to the ground and suffer serious injuries. title: CPSC, Shelcore Inc. Announce Recall Children's Play Tables to Replace Mallets
summary: The mallet that comes as part of this table set can be lodged into the throats of young children, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 124,000.

title: Oil Burning Candles Recalled by Target
summary: The glass on these candles can shatter, creating a fire hazard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Teethers Recalled by Manhattan Group LLC
summary: The teether can pull apart easily and expose small pieces. This poses choking and aspiration hazards to young children. Units: About 22,000.
